## What this changes

A short description of the change and the motivation.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New rewrite rule / equivalence certificate
- [ ] New provider or matching capability
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactor / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `ruff format --check .` passes
- [ ] `pytest` passes (the suite is fully offline)
- [ ] New/changed behavior is covered by a test
- [ ] For a new proven rule: an equivalent **and** a deliberately-broken fixture
      are both classified correctly
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`

## Notes for reviewers

Anything that needs special attention (opset assumptions, tolerance choices, etc.).
